item.lead:
You have stoi: character to position. A model also needs the way back, from a number to its character.

Look at the two comprehensions below, one under the other. Only the order of the two names changes, and that swap is the whole reversal.
item.follow: You saw that itos is stoi with key and value swapped, so either table undoes the other. With both tables in place, the next beat can turn whole strings into numbers and back.
